Common questions

What is the minimum bulk order?
Five cartons of a single fragrance, or a mixed pallet of five cartons across the range.
How is payment handled?
50% advance by NEFT/UPI against a proforma invoice, balance before dispatch. Approved dealers get 30-day credit.
Do you ship outside Bihar?
Yes. We dispatch by road transport across nine states, and by courier for smaller consignments.
